import json, sqlite3, urllib.request, urllib.error
base='http://127.0.0.1:3100'
def req(path, method='GET', body=None):
    data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=data,method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try:
      with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as x:return x.status,json.load(x)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as x:return x.code,json.load(x)
docs=json.load(open('/tmp/docs.json')); assert len(docs)==1,docs
id=docs[0]['id']; status,d=req('/api/documents/'+id); assert status==200 and d['revision']==1
lines=d['content'].split('\n'); assert len(lines)==1226,len(lines); assert lines[-1]=='The editor must preserve this tail sentinel: OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.'
assert 'ALPHA-0001' in lines[23] and 'ALPHA-1200' in lines[-4]
# mismatch is rejected and untouched
assert req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':'wrong','baseRevision':1,'content':'bad'})[0]==400
# save creates revision 2
changed=d['content']+'\nverification'; status,s=req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':1,'content':changed}); assert status==200 and s['document']['revision']==2
# stale tab rejected
status,c=req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':1,'content':'overwrite'}); assert status==409
# unchanged does not revise
status,u=req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':2,'content':changed}); assert status==200 and u['unchanged'] and u['document']['revision']==2
# restore prior becomes revision 3 and preserves history
status,r=req('/api/documents/'+id+'/restore/1','POST',{'id':id,'baseRevision':2}); assert status==200 and r['document']['revision']==3 and r['document']['content']==d['content']
status,h=req('/api/documents/'+id+'/revisions'); assert [x['revision'] for x in h]==[3,2,1]
con=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/patchpad-test.sqlite'); assert con.execute('select count(*) from documents').fetchone()[0]==1; assert con.execute('select count(*) from revisions').fetchone()[0]==3
meta=con.execute('select seed_metadata from documents').fetchone()[0]; assert json.loads(meta)['document']['generatedLineCount']==1200
print('API and seed checks passed:',len(lines),'lines, revisions', [x['revision'] for x in h])
PY
